#### 四、交付派发方的可复现断言清单

以下为派发方在浏览器控制台或 DOM 测试环境中复跑的断言脚本：

```js
import { lockScroll, unlockScroll, resetScrollLock } from './src/ui/parts/scrollLock';
import { openLightbox, closeLightbox } from './src/ui/parts/lightbox';
import { openEventForm, openRecordForm, closeFormModal } from './src/ui/parts/formModal';

// --- 断言准备 ---
resetScrollLock();
console.assert(document.body.classList.contains('is-locked') === false, '初始状态 body 不应有 is-locked');

// --- 断言 1：打开灯箱 ---
openLightbox('data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNk+M9QDwADhgGAWjR9awAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==');
console.assert(document.body.classList.contains('is-locked') === true, '断言1失败：打开灯箱后 is-locked 应为 true');

// --- 断言 2：灯箱开着时打开表单，再关闭表单 ---
openEventForm({ mode: 'create' }); // 叠开表单
console.assert(document.body.classList.contains('is-locked') === true, '表单打开时 is-locked 仍应为 true');
closeFormModal(true); // 关闭表单
console.assert(document.body.classList.contains('is-locked') === true, '断言2失败：关闭表单后下层灯箱仍在，is-locked 仍应为 true');

// --- 断言 3：再关闭灯箱 ---
closeLightbox();
console.assert(document.body.classList.contains('is-locked') === false, '断言3失败：关闭全部浮层后 is-locked 应为 false');

// --- 断言 4：连续多次解锁边界（防止多解锁产生负计数残留）---
resetScrollLock();
lockScroll();   // count=1 (is-locked=true)
lockScroll();   // count=2
unlockScroll(); // count=1
unlockScroll(); // count=0 (is-locked=false)
unlockScroll(); // count=0 (safe no-op)
console.assert(document.body.classList.contains('is-locked') === false, '断言4.1失败：连续多解锁后 is-locked 应为 false');
lockScroll();   // 从 0 再次加锁应立即变为 true
console.assert(document.body.classList.contains('is-locked') === true, '断言4.2失败：无负计数，单次 lockScroll 应恢复 is-locked');
unlockScroll();
console.assert(document.body.classList.contains('is-locked') === false, '断言4.3失败：unlockScroll 后应回到 false');

// --- 断言 5：记录表单锁点（1790 行链路）专项验证 ---
resetScrollLock();
lockScroll(); // 模拟外层已有浮层（例如详情浮层）
console.assert(document.body.classList.contains('is-locked') === true, '外层浮层加锁成功');
openRecordForm({ eventId: 'mock-event-id' }); // 触发 1790 行的 lockScroll()
closeFormModal(true); // 关闭记录表单
console.assert(document.body.classList.contains('is-locked') === true, '断言5失败：1790锁点生效，关闭记录表单后外层锁不得被吞掉');
unlockScroll(); // 关闭外层浮层
console.assert(document.body.classList.contains('is-locked') === false, '外层浮层关闭后回到 false');
```
